metadata.title: Artist packages for brands
metadata.description: Artist collaborations for brands: concept, handmade production, social content and experiences that present craftsmanship and ideas authentically.

hero.pachete_personalizate_cu_artistii_cu_car: Customized packages with the artists we work with: painting, clay and whatever else your brand needs.

ce_primesti.pentru_o_campanie_un_produs_sau_un_ambal: For a campaign, product or package.
ce_primesti.pentru_continut_sau_pentru_spatiul_tau: For content or for your space.
ce_primesti.o_lansare_sau_un_eveniment_care_merita_c: A launch or event that deserves something unique.

ce_primesti.artistii_sunt_creditati_in_fiecare_proie: Artists are credited in every project and also feature on the NA account.

artistii.pictorita_profesionista_cu_o_viziune_car: A professional painter with an instantly recognizable vision. She creates commissioned paintings, each inspired by the person or story behind it. For a brand, that means one-of-a-kind artwork unlike anything else in the feed.
artistii.artist_in_lut_face_figurine_obiecte_si_v: A clay artist who makes figurines, objects and vases. Every piece passes through his hands, from its first shape to the final detail, so no two are alike.

pentru_cine_e.brandurile_care_vor_ceva_unic_nu_inca_o: Brands that want something unique—not another generated image.
pentru_cine_e.lansarile_si_evenimentele_care_au_nevoie: Launches and events that need an object or an artwork.
pentru_cine_e.cine_vrea_in_continut_lucruri_care_se_po: Brands that want tangible things in their content: painting, clay and one-of-a-kind objects.
pentru_cine_e.lavinia_si_bianca_coordoneaza_artistii_n: Lavinia and Bianca coordinate; our artists create.
